- **F003-i0 #1 (missing-summary lacks Add Project)** — `dashboard/lib/project-selector-logic.js:renderMissingSummaryHTML()` now appends `renderAddProjectHTML()` so the `dontpanic projects add <name> <path>` command-emission row is rendered whether the fleet summary is present or absent. The new `'still surfaces Add Project command-emission in the missing-summary state'` integration test pins this.

- **F003-i0 #2 (`refreshState()` cannot transition present→missing)** — `dashboard/core.js:loadState()` now carries a `nullableMissing` flag on the aliased `fleetSummary` and `whatNow` entries; both reset to `null` on non-OK responses *and* fetch failures, so when an operator deletes the cache file the missing banner actually renders on the next refresh tick.
